<function name="GetFraction" parent="DNumberWang" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Returns a fraction representing the current number selector value to number selector min/max range ratio. If argument `val` is supplied, that number will be computed instead.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="val" type="number">The fraction numerator.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Prints out some fractions based on a number selector with a min/max range of 0 to 255.</description>
	<code>
local numinput = vgui.Create("DNumberWang")
numinput:SetPos(5, 5)
numinput:SetSize(90, 20)

numinput:SetMinMax(0, 255)

numinput:SetValue(64)

print(numinput:GetFraction())	-- Should return ~0.25
print(numinput:GetFraction(128))	-- Should return ~0.5
print(numinput:GetFraction(192))	-- Should return ~0.75
print(numinput:GetFraction(255))	-- Should return 1
	</code>
	<output>

```
0.25098039215686
0.50196078431373
0.75294117647059
1
```

	</output>

</example>
